hero.headline: Getting into an Italian university is the easy part.
hero.subhead: Visa, residence permit, fiscal code, municipal registration, health cover, housing — that's the part almost no one warns you about. We handle it with you, step by step.

problemScale.heading: The part after admission is a maze
problemScale.body: Between your acceptance letter and your first day of class, you'll deal with a consulate, a university, a post office, an immigration office, a tax agency, and your local municipality — each with its own deadlines and its own paperwork.

pillars.title: Before you leave
pillars.body: University applications, Universitaly, qualification recognition, and a visa file prepared to the standard your consulate expects.

pillars.title: After you land
pillars.body: Residence permit, fiscal code, municipal registration, and health cover — inside the deadlines that actually matter.

pillars.title: Finding a place to live
pillars.body: Contract review, lease registration, and protection from the scams that target students applying from abroad.

processPreview.heading: The full path, mapped out
processPreview.body: From your first application to your residence permit, here's exactly what happens and when — including the 8-day deadline almost no one mentions.

packagesPreview.heading: Three levels of support
packagesPreview.body: Choose how far you want us to go with you — from getting your application right, to being there when you land, to having a verified place to live.

trustBuilding.heading: Why trust a company that started this year
trustBuilding.body: We won't show you fabricated numbers or fake reviews — we don't have either. What we can show you is exactly how we work: the same process, described in detail, that we'd walk you through on a call.

finalCta.heading: Talk to us before you apply
finalCta.body: 15 minutes, no cost, no obligation. Tell us where you are in the process and we'll tell you exactly what comes next.
